note: The draw: which cases were labelled, out of what population, at what sampling fraction. This is label-align.py --sample's INPUT, not only provenance. It used to be provenance, and re-deriving the strata from (split, verdict) instead weighted the held-out tranche against the whole test split; a grade set that has moved since the draw can no longer reconstruct which stratum a case was sampled from, so the draw has to say. held_out_from is the tranche floor this cut used. Cut with --held-out-from 168: the default was 122, which would have re-sampled the batch-4 tranche that 0.2.0 labelling already spent.
